rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Hong Kong Cantonese word for a sweater or pullover.

example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 laang1 saam1 hou2 nyun5

rows.note: Use this for a short temporary wire or conductor used to link parts of an electrical circuit.

example.english: This jumper is loose; should we replace it with a new one?
example.traditional: 呢條跳線鬆咗，要唔要換條新嘅？
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 tiu3 sin3 sung1 zo2 jiu3 m4 jiu3 wun6 tiu4 san1 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the removable jumper cap or link fitted on a circuit board.

example.english: That jumper cap on the circuit board fell off—can you find it?
example.traditional: 塊電路板上面嗰粒跳線帽跌咗，搵唔搵得返？
example.jyutping: faai3 din6 lou6 baan2 soeng6 min6 go2 nap1 tiu3 sin3 mou6 dit3 zo2 wan2 m4 wan2 dak1 faan1
